svg.title: Deploy CCX on the standby cluster
svg.desc: CCX is deployed to the standby cluster with the primary values, or, if you use ArgoCD, by switching its destination.

g.aria-label: Step 1: ccxdb and cmon db replicate from the primary to the standby cluster
Step 2: the k8s resource backup job and datastore backups write to S3
Step 3: on DR, restore k8s resources from S3 into the standby; its ExternalDNS updates the DNS zone
Step 4: deploy CCX to the standby with the same values, or switch the ArgoCD destination
Step 5: restore any missing datastores from their S3 backups
